description:
Hello, and thank you to everyone who enjoys this wallpaper! Thank you as well for your suggestions and feedback. I hope she brings a little warmth to your desktop and makes your day feel more relaxed and comfortable.
The wallpaper itself is free forever, and its content will remain romantic and non-explicit.

Here are answers to some questions that come up often in the comments:

1. Why are some parts of the image soft, or why does playback stutter?
Most videos were generated with Seedance 2.5 at 720p, then upscaled and interpolated to 4K/60 FPS with Topaz. Although the final video is 4K, its details are not equivalent to native 4K and some areas may look soft. I’ll continue trying to improve this in future updates. Currently, only “Purple Mist Veil” uses 1080p source footage, so you can compare the visual difference. If playback stutters, try lowering “Video Quality” to 2K or 1080p in Wallpaper Engine’s settings. Choose the level that looks good and runs smoothly on your computer; 4K is not required.

2. Why don’t the wallpaper buttons respond?
Some desktop utilities, including Xiaoniao Wallpaper and Tencent Desktop Organizer, may conflict with the wallpaper’s mouse interaction. Try closing those programs and testing the buttons again.

3. Could you add small movements, such as head turns or swaying hair, or make a version without shoes?
The character’s movements come from video, not a real-time controllable 3D model or Live2D. Head turns, hair movement, leg movement, or changing footwear usually require generating and processing new video, so they cannot simply be adjusted on the existing footage. I’ll keep exploring improvements and updates when time allows, and you’re welcome to leave suggestions in the comments.

4. How was this wallpaper made?
In short, the videos were prepared first, then the interface and features were built through iterative conversations with Codex. The result was previewed, tested, adjusted, and packaged as a web wallpaper that can be imported into Wallpaper Engine. Features such as outfit changes, favorites, still frames, and Moving Companion were gradually developed this way.

This wallpaper is a personal hobby project made in my spare time, so updates may be slow due to limited time and resources. I read your comments and suggestions carefully; please understand if I can’t reply right away. I’ll continue improving it when I can. Thank you for your patience and support, and I hope it brings a little comfort and companionship to your everyday life.

Update notes — 2026-10-16
- Added three Moving Companion outfits: “First Snow Fluff,” “Purple Mist Veil,” and “Starlight at Night.” Selecting one enables the mode automatically; after the entrance animation, its idle motion loops continuously.
- Added Compact Layout, which takes up less space and obscures less of the artwork. Choose your preferred layout in Settings.
- Added video quality options: 4K, 2K, and 1080p. Lower the setting if playback stutters.
- Added rotation across wardrobes: “Rotate All” and “Favorites Across All” can play outfits from different wardrobes continuously.
- Added a custom outfit-change interval, configurable in seconds or minutes.
- Improved saving and restoring Immersive Mode. Wallpaper Engine settings now include “Interface on Startup,” with options to remember the previous state, start immersed, or show the interface.
- Refined details and fixed issues such as blank areas in Settings and the still-frame picker not closing when clicked.

Update notes — 2026-10-23
- Added 6 Moving Companion outfits with exclusive dialogue.
- Wardrobes now support ascending and descending order; browsing no longer changes outfits automatically.
- Rotation supports in-order and random playback, with smoother transitions between outfits.
- Affectionate dialogue is easier to trigger, and several interface details were fixed.
- If the interface behaves unexpectedly after an update, reapply the wallpaper or restart Wallpaper Engine. If problems persist, try “Restore Defaults” in the wallpaper settings; this clears favorites, custom still frames, and personal settings. If downloads are incomplete or resources are missing, unsubscribe, restart Steam, and subscribe again. If the issue remains, please report it with screenshots and steps to reproduce.

AI Generated. All characters are fictional.
